comment: The crossover frequencies are 50, 75, 110, 160, 235, 345, 500, 730, 1070, 1560, 2280, 3330, 4870, 7120 and 10000Hz, DB16.cpp:67-70; the panel prints them rounded, so the band the panel calls 1K runs to 1070Hz. The maker's tooltip on the upper half output reads 730K-24K HZ, a slip for 730Hz.
